name: Sew an even running stitch
description: Make a line of straight stitches with gaps of about the same length, including on the underside.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Sew an even running stitch.

levels.name: Match one stitch and one gap
levels.completion_criterion: Make the first stitch, then leave a gap about as long as that stitch.
levels.can_do: Match one stitch and one gap
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Keep the surface even
levels.completion_criterion: Continue along a short line so the stitches you see match each other.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Check the underside
levels.completion_criterion: Turn the cloth and show that the stitches underneath are evenly spaced too.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

name: Baste two layers with stitches you can pull out
description: Hold two scraps with long temporary stitches, then take the thread out.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Baste two layers with stitches you can pull out.

levels.name: Sew a few long stitches
levels.completion_criterion: Pin two scraps and sew a few long stitches that are easy to see.
levels.safety_requirements: Basting is temporary. Do not use it as the only seam on something that will be worn or pulled.

levels.name: Tug the layers
levels.completion_criterion: Hold the layers and tug once. The stitches should still hold them.
levels.safety_requirements: Basting is temporary. Do not use it as the only seam on something that will be worn or pulled.

levels.name: Pull the thread out
levels.completion_criterion: Draw the thread out and separate the layers.
levels.safety_requirements: Basting is temporary. Do not use it as the only seam on something that will be worn or pulled.

safety_notes: Basting is temporary. Do not use it as the only seam on something that will be worn or pulled.

name: Sew a back stitch with no gaps
description: Work each surface stitch backward into the end of the one before, so the line is solid.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Sew a back stitch with no gaps.

levels.name: Make the first backward stitch
levels.completion_criterion: Come up a stitch-length along the line and go down at the start.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Close the next gap
levels.completion_criterion: Come up ahead and go down into the end of the previous stitch.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Show a solid line
levels.completion_criterion: Show a short line whose surface stitches touch, with no gap between them.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

name: Sew a chain of loops
description: Make interlocking loops, each held by the next, and finish the last loop with a small stitch.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Sew a chain of loops.

levels.name: Leave one loop
levels.completion_criterion: Come up and go down in the same place, leaving a loop on the surface.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Anchor it
levels.completion_criterion: Come up inside that loop and pull the loop snug against the needle.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Hold the last loop
levels.completion_criterion: Make a second loop the same way, then secure the last loop with a small holding stitch.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

name: Fill a small shape with satin stitch
description: Lay straight stitches side by side, all in one direction, until a small shape reads as a solid patch.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Fill a small shape with satin stitch.

levels.name: Lay two touching stitches
levels.completion_criterion: Place two straight stitches next to each other, parallel and touching.
levels.safety_requirements: A split-stitch edge is optional and is a different stitch. Do not claim the reverse matches unless you look.

levels.name: Fill one side
levels.completion_criterion: Fill one half of a small shape with stitches that stay parallel.
levels.safety_requirements: A split-stitch edge is optional and is a different stitch. Do not claim the reverse matches unless you look.

levels.name: Finish the patch
levels.completion_criterion: Fill the other half. The shape should read as a solid patch, not as scattered lines.
levels.safety_requirements: A split-stitch edge is optional and is a different stitch. Do not claim the reverse matches unless you look.

safety_notes: A split-stitch edge is optional and is a different stitch. Do not claim the reverse matches unless you look.

name: Sew a stem stitch that twists
description: Come up beside the previous stitch, always on the same side, so a short line looks like a cord.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Sew a stem stitch that twists.

levels.name: Start beside the first stitch
levels.completion_criterion: Make one straight stitch, then come up about halfway along it, to one side.
levels.safety_requirements: Shorten the stitches on a tight curve. Sew on scrap.

levels.name: Keep one side
levels.completion_criterion: Keep the thread on that same side of the needle for the next stitch.
levels.safety_requirements: Shorten the stitches on a tight curve. Sew on scrap.

levels.name: Show the cord
levels.completion_criterion: Finish a short line in which each stitch begins about halfway along the one before.
levels.safety_requirements: Shorten the stitches on a tight curve. Sew on scrap.

safety_notes: Shorten the stitches on a tight curve. Sew on scrap.

name: Sew a herringbone band
description: Cross diagonal stitches between two lines so they pass near each other's ends.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Sew a herringbone band.

levels.name: Sew the first diagonal
levels.completion_criterion: Draw two parallel lines and sew one diagonal from the lower line to the upper line.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. This is a band, not a claim that the reverse is a particular stitch.

levels.name: Cross near the end
levels.completion_criterion: Come up a little behind that point and sew a diagonal that crosses the first near its end.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. This is a band, not a claim that the reverse is a particular stitch.

levels.name: Continue the band
levels.completion_criterion: Add more diagonals until you have a short band of crossed stitches.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. This is a band, not a claim that the reverse is a particular stitch.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. This is a band, not a claim that the reverse is a particular stitch.

name: Sew one fly stitch
description: Pull a straight stitch into a V with a stitch that anchors the loop.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Sew one fly stitch.

levels.name: Leave a loop
levels.completion_criterion: Take the needle up and down a short distance apart, leaving a loop.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. A longer anchor turns it into a Y; say so if you do that.

levels.name: Make the V
levels.completion_criterion: Come up inside the loop so the thread pulls the stitch into a V.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. A longer anchor turns it into a Y; say so if you do that.

levels.name: Anchor it
levels.completion_criterion: Take the needle down just beyond the V so a small stitch holds it when you let go.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. A longer anchor turns it into a Y; say so if you do that.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. A longer anchor turns it into a Y; say so if you do that.

name: Split the thread of the previous stitch
description: Bring the needle up through the middle of the stitch you just made, so the line looks like a fine chain.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Split the thread of the previous stitch.

levels.name: Make one stitch
levels.completion_criterion: Sew one straight stitch on the line and pull the thread through.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. This is not the same as coming up in the hole beside the stitch.

levels.name: Split it
levels.completion_criterion: Bring the needle up through the middle of that stitch so the thread splits.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. This is not the same as coming up in the hole beside the stitch.

levels.name: Continue the line
levels.completion_criterion: Make the next stitch the same way, so each stitch is split by the one that follows.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. This is not the same as coming up in the hole beside the stitch.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. This is not the same as coming up in the hole beside the stitch.

name: Sew one detached chain
description: Make a single loop and hold it with a small stitch, without starting a second loop.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Sew one detached chain.

levels.name: Form one loop
levels.completion_criterion: Come up, go down in the same place, and keep a loop on the surface.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. A row of loops is the chain stitch, not this one.

levels.name: Snug the loop
levels.completion_criterion: Come up inside the loop and draw it snug against the needle.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. A row of loops is the chain stitch, not this one.

levels.name: Hold it and stop
levels.completion_criterion: Take a small stitch over the end of the loop. It stays, and you do not start another loop.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. A row of loops is the chain stitch, not this one.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. A row of loops is the chain stitch, not this one.

name: Capture a pawn en passant
description: On the move just after a pawn advances two squares, capture it as if it had moved only one.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Capture a pawn en passant.

levels.name: Set the moment
levels.completion_criterion: Set a pawn that has just moved two squares beside an opposing pawn that can capture it.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a practice board. The 2023 FIDE laws describe this capture. This is not a tournament ruling.

levels.name: Take it now
levels.completion_criterion: Move the capturing pawn to the square the other pawn passed, and remove the captured pawn.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a practice board. The 2023 FIDE laws describe this capture. This is not a tournament ruling.

levels.name: Name the limit
levels.completion_criterion: Say that this capture is legal only on that next move, and do not play it a move later.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a practice board. The 2023 FIDE laws describe this capture. This is not a tournament ruling.

safety_notes: Use a practice board. The 2023 FIDE laws describe this capture. This is not a tournament ruling.

name: Say why castling is stopped
description: Point to the reason a castle cannot be played: a moved king or rook, a piece in the way, or the king moving through an attacked square.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Say why castling is stopped.

levels.name: Show a clear castle
levels.completion_criterion: Point to a king and rook that have not moved, with empty squares between them.
levels.safety_requirements: A castle on an empty side is already a separate skill. This one is the reason a castle is illegal. Practice only.

levels.name: Find one stop
levels.completion_criterion: Point to one block: a piece between them, or the king's square, the square it crosses, or the square it would land on being attacked.
levels.safety_requirements: A castle on an empty side is already a separate skill. This one is the reason a castle is illegal. Practice only.

levels.name: Leave the pieces
levels.completion_criterion: Do not play the castle, and say which reason you found.
levels.safety_requirements: A castle on an empty side is already a separate skill. This one is the reason a castle is illegal. Practice only.

safety_notes: A castle on an empty side is already a separate skill. This one is the reason a castle is illegal. Practice only.

name: Move the piece you touched
description: On a practice board, if you touch your own piece, move that piece if it has a legal move.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Move the piece you touched.

levels.name: Touch one piece
levels.completion_criterion: Touch one of your pieces that has a legal move.
levels.safety_requirements: This adapts the touch-move article for a practice board. It does not settle a dispute in a rated game.

levels.name: Move that piece
levels.completion_criterion: Move the piece you touched, not a different one.
levels.safety_requirements: This adapts the touch-move article for a practice board. It does not settle a dispute in a rated game.

levels.name: Name a capture
levels.completion_criterion: If you had touched an opponent's piece instead, say that you would have to capture it when that capture is legal.
levels.safety_requirements: This adapts the touch-move article for a practice board. It does not settle a dispute in a rated game.

safety_notes: This adapts the touch-move article for a practice board. It does not settle a dispute in a rated game.

name: Offer a draw before you press the clock
description: Make the move, offer the draw, and only then press the clock. Wait for an answer.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Offer a draw before you press the clock.

levels.name: Move first
levels.completion_criterion: Make a legal move on the board.
levels.safety_requirements: Some events forbid draw offers. This is the sequence from the laws when an offer is allowed, not advice to force a draw.

levels.name: Offer before the press
levels.completion_criterion: Say that you offer a draw before you press your clock.
levels.safety_requirements: Some events forbid draw offers. This is the sequence from the laws when an offer is allowed, not advice to force a draw.

levels.name: Wait for the answer
levels.completion_criterion: Do not play another move until the other person has accepted or refused.
levels.safety_requirements: Some events forbid draw offers. This is the sequence from the laws when an offer is allowed, not advice to force a draw.

safety_notes: Some events forbid draw offers. This is the sequence from the laws when an offer is allowed, not advice to force a draw.

name: Write one chess move in algebraic notation
description: Write one move with the square names so another person can play it.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Write one chess move in algebraic notation.

levels.name: Name the squares
levels.completion_criterion: Point to the square a piece leaves and the square it lands on, using the file letter and the rank number.
levels.safety_requirements: One move is enough. Do not record moves in advance of playing them.

levels.name: Write the arrival
levels.completion_criterion: Write the landing square, and a letter for the piece when it is not a pawn.
levels.safety_requirements: One move is enough. Do not record moves in advance of playing them.

levels.name: Hand it over
levels.completion_criterion: Give the note to another person and have them play that one move.
levels.safety_requirements: One move is enough. Do not record moves in advance of playing them.

safety_notes: One move is enough. Do not record moves in advance of playing them.

name: Sing a tune in unison before a round
description: Sing a short tune together, without a leader feeding the notes, before anyone starts late.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Sing a tune in unison before a round.

levels.name: Sing it once together
levels.completion_criterion: Sing or speak a short tune all the way through as one group.
levels.safety_requirements: Stop if voices strain. The page says a round before the tune is secure is the common mistake.

levels.name: Sing it without a leader
levels.completion_criterion: Sing it again while nobody mouths the notes ahead of the group.
levels.safety_requirements: Stop if voices strain. The page says a round before the tune is secure is the common mistake.

levels.name: Stay together if it slips
levels.completion_criterion: If the tune falls apart, stay in unison. Do not split into a round yet.
levels.safety_requirements: Stop if voices strain. The page says a round before the tune is secure is the common mistake.

safety_notes: Stop if voices strain. The page says a round before the tune is secure is the common mistake.

name: Bring in the next voice of a round
description: Cue a second group to start at the next phrase, quietly enough that both groups can hear each other.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Bring in the next voice of a round.

levels.name: Agree the entry
levels.completion_criterion: Agree which phrase is the moment the second voice starts.
levels.safety_requirements: Face each other if that helps listening. Do not put every confident singer in one group and announce that you did.

levels.name: Cue it
levels.completion_criterion: Cue the second group at that phrase while the first group continues.
levels.safety_requirements: Face each other if that helps listening. Do not put every confident singer in one group and announce that you did.

levels.name: Keep it audible
levels.completion_criterion: Keep both parts quiet enough that each group can hear the other. If it falls apart, stop and return to unison.
levels.safety_requirements: Face each other if that helps listening. Do not put every confident singer in one group and announce that you did.

safety_notes: Face each other if that helps listening. Do not put every confident singer in one group and announce that you did.

name: End a round one group at a time
description: Cue one group to stop at the end of its line, then let the other group finish its own line.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks End a round one group at a time.

levels.name: Choose the group
levels.completion_criterion: While the round is going, point to the group that will stop at the end of its line.
levels.safety_requirements: Ending everybody on the same beat is a different, harder ending. This is the one-group-at-a-time ending.

levels.name: Cue the stop
levels.completion_criterion: Cue that group to stop, and let the other group keep going to the end of its line.
levels.safety_requirements: Ending everybody on the same beat is a different, harder ending. This is the one-group-at-a-time ending.

levels.name: Reach silence
levels.completion_criterion: Wait until both groups are silent, and say which group stopped first.
levels.safety_requirements: Ending everybody on the same beat is a different, harder ending. This is the one-group-at-a-time ending.

safety_notes: Ending everybody on the same beat is a different, harder ending. This is the one-group-at-a-time ending.
